title: Optimize JPEG Huffman tables for decoding cost, not only file size

definition.title: Optimize JPEG Huffman tables for decoding cost, not only file size
definition.source_excerpt: Rewrite valid JPEG Huffman tables and entropy serialization while preserving quantized coefficients and other image semantics. Compare size-optimized tables, decoder cost, complete image output and preparation break-even.
